text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Iceclad＞ (Other than against Security Digimon, compare the number of digivolution cards instead of DP in this Digimon's battles.) [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.

text_sections.label: Security Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ until the end of their turn.
